research_notes: Reporting currency: the audited FS are presented in thousands of US dollars (USD is the functional and presentation currency, FS2025 Note 3l). All money values are stored in USD million (FS USD thousand / 1,000); EPS is stored in USD per share as printed (4 decimals only), DPS in rupiah as paid.

Source policy: each FY uses its own audited consolidated FS (FS2022-FS2025 from pge.pertamina.com). FY2019-FY2021 come from the audited FS re-issued for the IPO (auditor's reports 4 Nov 2022), printed in Chapter XIX of the final prospectus (20 Feb 2023). They equal the FS2022 comparatives. The 29-Mar-2022 re-issue of FS2021 on the IR page differs only in FY2021 lease liabilities, total liabilities and equity (by 162 thousand), as noted on those datums. The ARs for 2022-2025 are linked from the official IR page https://pge.pertamina.com/en/report to Google Drive, so the Drive URL is the company's own published copy. The ARs supply EBITDA, payout ratios, year-end prices, production and ROE/ROA.

IPO and listing: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk listed on the IDX on 24 Feb 2023 (offer of 10,350,000,000 new shares at Rp875). No year-end price exists for FY2019-FY2022, so those are null. The legal name has not changed (AR2025 PDF p. 80, 'the Company has not undergone any name changes'). Controlling shareholder: PT Pertamina Power Indonesia, 68.18% at 30 Jun 2026. Masdar Indonesia Solar Holdings RSC Ltd holds 14.82% and PT Pertamina Pedeve Indonesia 5.91%.

Pre-listing share history, deliberately NOT recorded in corporate_actions: (1) June 2021 circular resolution: capitalisation of retained earnings US$908,341 thousand and debt-to-equity swap US$111,421 thousand, taking the shares from 775,256 to 15,523,071 (Rp1,000,000 par). (2) 10 Feb 2022 (Notarial Deed 12): nominal value Rp1,000,000 -> Rp500, i.e. a 1:2,000 split, taking 15,523,071 to 31,046,142,000 shares (FS2021 Note 35, PDF p. 141). Both happened before the shares traded, so there is no ex-date and no price to adjust. Every per-share value stored here is already on the post-split basis: EPS 2020-2021 from the re-issued FS (31,046,142,000 weighted shares), FY2021 shares_out 31,046,142,000. FY2020 shares_out is null. Recording the 2022 split would also make bin/stocks_prices.php reject PGEO, because Yahoo has no matching split event.

Corporate actions since listing: none of type split, reverse split, rights or bonus. 2023-2026 EGMS agendas were management changes only (EGMS minutes 2024, Aug 2025, Jan 2026). Share-count changes after the IPO come only from MESOP option exercises: 41,396,142,000 (2023), 41,508,024,149 (2024), 41,815,763,396 (2025), 41,899,535,623 (30 Jun 2026). MESOP is not a schema corporate-action type. No treasury shares at any FY end.

Presentation change: up to FY2023 the FS put finance income and other income/expense (incl. FX and impairment) above 'Laba usaha', so operating profit 2020-2023 includes them. FS2024 (Note 38) reclassified FY2023 (operating profit 265,176 -> 226,055; CFO 253,006 -> 255,190; cost of revenue / G&A split), and FS2025 reclassified FY2024 cost of revenue vs G&A (operating profit unchanged). Stored values are as originally reported. The operating_profit series breaks between 2023 and 2024.

FY2019 revenue (666,876) includes JOC contractor revenue gross. The policy changed in 2020, and the prospectus uses an 'adjusted revenue' of 328,208 for 2019 margins. FY2019 revenue is therefore not comparable with later years.

EBITDA is the company's own measure. The definition in the prospectus (PDF p. 31) is profit before finance costs net of finance income, income tax, depreciation and amortisation, and other (income)/expense net. Values: prospectus for 2020-2021 (2019 = 258,077 there, not required), then each year's AR MD&A table (2022 AR2022, 2023 AR2023, 2024 AR2024, 2025 AR2025). AR2025 and the FY25 deck restate FY2024 EBITDA from 324,512 to 324,061, and the original is stored.

total_debt = interest-bearing borrowings only (the bank loan of 2021-2022, the USD400 mn 5.15% green notes due 2028 issued 27 Apr 2023, and the long-term loans from Pertamina, which are JICA / World Bank two-step loans on-lent by Pertamina, Note 26j). Lease liabilities are excluded. In 2019-2020, 'other payables - related parties' (285,178 / 315,719) were non-loan payables to Pertamina, largely interest settled in 2021 (FY2021 cash flow: interest payments on loans to Pertamina 281,920), and are excluded.

fx_usd_idr: the FS state that monetary items are translated at the Bank Indonesia JISDOR rate at the reporting date (FS2025 Note 3l), but they print the rate only as a 2-decimal 'USD per 1,000 Rupiah' (0.06/0.07). The stored rate is therefore the JISDOR fixing from Bank Indonesia's JISDOR page (source_type official) on the last fixing date on or before 31 Dec.
